findings.desc: SlimStatusFetchCacheTest exercises the cache in isolation (different-key miss, concurrent single-flight) but never invokes StatusFetchService + BackgroundUnreadPoller against one shared cache instance — so the regression test would still pass if one caller reverted to a directory key. Same gap rev-kimi flagged.
findings.status: accepted non-blocking — production wiring verified correct by inspection (both callers use hostProfileId ?: DEFAULT_CACHE_KEY); guarded by SlimStatusFetchCacheTest different-key→no-dedup + the corrected comment (af2e8d17).

findings.desc: cacheKey is hostProfileId only, not endpointFp. An endpoint-only reconfigure (same profileId, different endpointFp) could serve a stale cached result for up to 10s. StatusAggregatorImpl fences pre-reconfigure requests, but a post-reconfigure cache hit has the current epoch; BackgroundUnreadPoller.identityValid() does not check endpoint.
findings.status: accepted non-blocking — adding endpointFp to the key would require threading it to BOTH callers; BackgroundUnreadPoller lacks ready endpointFp access, so asymmetric keys would re-diverge and break dedup (worse). Practical risk near-zero: endpoint-only-reconfigure is rare, 10s TTL bounds the window, authority reducer intersects with the current tree (stale cross-endpoint sids dropped), sids are unique. Mitigated by TTL + reducer intersection. Documented as an explicit cache-scope tradeoff.
